# Corcoran Communications

> Veteran-owned, AI-powered marketing agency in Quakertown, Pennsylvania.
> AI-built websites, automated SEO/AEO monitoring, lead generation,
> Google Ads, social media marketing, and content marketing for
> businesses in Bucks and Montgomery Counties and the Greater Lehigh
> Valley.
> Call or text 215-259-8304. Email greg@corcoranpr.com.

Corcoran Communications is led by owner Greg Quinn, a U.S. Navy veteran
who served from 2006 to 2011 as a cryptologic technician aboard the USS
Chancellorsville, and a Temple University graduate. He is supported by
five AI agents. Two cover client websites and the search around them:
one audits site health every week, one tracks Google and AI-search
changes every morning. Three watch client advertising: one follows what
Google Ads is changing, one reports weekly on the account, and one turns
those reports into an action plan.
On top of the five, automated watchdog scripts inside client ad accounts
check spend pacing and conversion tracking daily. Greg reviews and
approves every change.
The firm was founded by Ruth Corcoran in January 2000 in Bear Creek,
Pennsylvania, doing public relations, design, content, and events. Her
son Greg headed sales and digital and
added SEO, social media, digital marketing, and lead generation before
taking over as owner in July 2023, when Ruth retired. The firm carries
over half a century of Corcoran family work in marketing, design, and
print. Past and present client work includes
Disney on Ice, Ringling Bros. Circus, Pittsburgh Craft Beer Week, SenArt
Films, Spirit Financial, Tri County Collision, and ILM.

## Services

- AI-Built Websites: fast, modern, schema-structured sites with no platform fees
- Automated SEO/AEO Monitoring: AI agents scan site health weekly and watch Google/AI-search changes daily, with plain-English reports clients can read
- Lead Generation: landing pages, offers, follow-up, and tracking measured in calls and booked jobs
- Google Ads: search and local campaigns, tightly managed, with watchdog scripts checking spend pacing and conversion tracking daily and AI agents reviewing the account weekly
- Social Media Marketing: Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok content and campaigns
- Content Marketing: blogs, email, and web copy structured to be quoted by AI search

## Location and service area

- Address: 1808 Enclave Dr, Quakertown, PA 18951
- Primary service area: Bucks County, Montgomery County, and the Greater Lehigh Valley (Lehigh and Northampton Counties), PA (Quakertown, Doylestown, Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton)
- Also serves longtime clients across Pennsylvania, New York, and New Jersey

## Practical answers

- To start: call or text 215-259-8304, or email greg@corcoranpr.com for a free AI-powered website audit.
- Accounts are led personally by the owner. No junior account teams.
- AEO (answer engine optimization) is a core service: getting businesses named in AI assistants' answers, not just ranked in search results.
